title: ID0384002-DC/Si-D/FI[Nokia] - Ghost session and outlet stuck
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Ghost session and 4 / 4 outlet OoO
Root cause: FW bug
Solution: Downgrade to v4.0.11
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status:
Ghost session is running and socket is stuck in "occupied" state. This generates penalty fee because no "stopTransaction" OCPP message.
As per requested by Product Champion, please assign this ticket to ES team to follow up investigation on Ghost Sessions
